_comment: Coverage floors per area of daemon/src, from `npm run coverage` (c8, json-summary).
`measured` is what the suite actually reached when the floor was last set; `floor` is a few
points below it so ordinary jitter does not fail a run. The rule is one-way: raise a floor
when coverage improves, never lower one. scripts/check-coverage.mjs enforces the floors and
test/coverage-floors.test.mjs keeps this file honest (no unlisted area, no floor above what
was measured, no floor more than 6 points below it — a stale floor gets tightened).
